summary: Annaly Capital Management filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to post a standard quarterly financial supplement for Q1 2026 on its website. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is announced. The filing is a routine financial update with no special-situation transaction or event. As a result, this is not a special situation and no further analysis is warranted.
